'''Zhellday''' was the name for the fourth [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Galactic Standard]] [[Standard week/Legends|week]] that was used on<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The [[Local day/Legends|day]] shared its name with the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] that once lived on Coruscant.<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], located in Coruscant's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] neighborhood, sold [[creamed Rishi corn soup]] for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on Zhelldays as part the diner's daily soup rotation. The diner also sold a [[Bantha burger/Legends|bantha burger]] with a cup of soup for 6.1 credits and [[Roast Smapp]] with hot [[barium liquid]] for 8.5 credits on Zhelldays.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zhellday was created<ref name="Story Behind the Story">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> for "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
